patch_description: This crossover keeps the baseline’s direct-demand link reward and combines it with the pressure-adjusted two-hop terms from the stronger prior implementation. It avoids the concave direct-demand blend, which performed worse in the reported results, and discounts two-hop routes through busier intermediate nodes or links with higher direct demand. The number of quadratic terms is at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\), within the stated limit. Degree penalties remain external to the returned terms.
